name: Dorcas
overview: The Scripture presents Dorcas, also known as Tabitha, as a devoted disciple in Joppa who was renowned for her good works and acts of charity, especially making garments for widows. When she fell sick and died, the disciples urgently sought Peter, who prayed and miraculously restored her to life, demonstrating God's power and affirming her faithful service to the community. This account highlights the impact of a Christ-centered life marked by generosity and the power of prayer in the early church.
